layer_3_action.subject: Amargasaurus
features: relatively short neck for a sauropod, distinctly featuring two parallel rows of long, elongated neural spines running down to the back
small, boxy skull with a blunt snout, a cleanly closed mouth, and large, soulful expressive yellow eyes
compact, muscular sauropod frame supported by stout, pillar-like limbs with rounded feet
short, thick tapering tail held elevated in a gentle curve off the ground
high-fidelity 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized, and slightly rounded contours
leathery skin texture with fine pebbled scales, shifting to a smooth horn-like keratin texture on the sharp tips of the neck spines
dusty terracotta base body color accented by vibrant teal-blue highlights tracing the neck spines, transitioning smoothly to a pale cream underbelly
layer_3_action.action: A calm, curious Amargasaurus stands peacefully near a riverbank, leaning its relatively short neck downward to reach low ferns, beautifully showcasing its unique split-spine profile against background hills of mottled red clay and green-grey siltstones under a bright, clear cinematic sun.
